title: Key West Tiki Bar Sunset Cruise (by the seat) BYOB Adventure
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
This tour requires a minimum of 2 paid participants
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Key West is famous for it's sunsets and it doesn't get any better then on an intimate sunset cruise aboard our custom tiki bar boats. You and up to 5 guests will toast the sunset with your favorite libation(BYOB). Tours depart an hour and fifteen minutes prior to sunset so we can get to the perfect place to watch the sunset. Our boats feature a large thatch roof for shade, bluetooth stereo, a walk in bathroom, adjustable padded bar stools and a gorgeous live edge tiki bar. You'll cruise the Key West harbor in style and view the famous sunset on your private 2 hour adventure. Keep your eyes on the horizon for a chance to see the famous Green Flash as the sun goes down.
